You are a formal verification engineer.
        Generate exactly 2 distinct SystemVerilog Assertions in this strict format, one assertion per line:
        assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (!rst_n) (<ANTECEDENT>) |-> (<CONSEQUENT>));

        Rules:
        1) Output exactly 2 assertion lines total. No explanation. No markdown. No numbering.
        2) Use only allowed signals listed below.
        3) Each candidate must contain exactly one implication operator total: either one |-> or one |=>.
        4) No helper/internal names such as next_state, count_next, count_prev, old(...), S_*.
        5) Keep the 2 candidates meaningfully different while staying semantically faithful.
        6) Prefer candidates that pass on correct behavior and fail on buggy behavior.
        7) Avoid vacuous antecedents: choose conditions that actually occur on the bug-revealing scenario.
        8) Infer a reusable relation, not a one-off witnessed cycle.
        9) Do not hard-code observed literals unless the spec or RTL independently justifies them.

        Allowed signals:
        clk, rst_n, d_i, q_sync_o, q_posedge_pulse_o, q_negedge_pulse_o

        Specification:
        q_posedge_pulse_o shall remain low on falling edges and assert only on rising edges.

Additional guidance:
- Use only the allowed interface-visible signals in the final assertion.

module prim_edge_detector #(
  parameter int unsigned Width = 1,

  parameter logic [Width-1:0] ResetValue = '0,

  // EnSync
  //
  // Enable Synchronizer to the input signal.
  // It is assumed that the input signal is glitch free (registered input).
  parameter bit EnSync  = 1'b 1
) (
  input clk_i,
  input rst_ni,

  input        [Width-1:0] d_i,
  output logic [Width-1:0] q_sync_o,

  output logic [Width-1:0] q_posedge_pulse_o,
  output logic [Width-1:0] q_negedge_pulse_o
);

  logic [Width-1:0] q_sync_d, q_sync_q;

  if (EnSync) begin : g_sync
    prim_flop_2sync #(
      .Width (Width),
      .ResetValue (ResetValue)
    ) u_sync (
      .clk_i,
      .rst_ni,
      .d_i,
      .q_o (q_sync_d)
    );
  end : g_sync
  else begin : g_nosync
// AUTO-SLICE KEEP assign lines 36-36 signals=d_i
    assign q_sync_d = d_i;
  end : g_nosync

// AUTO-SLICE KEEP assign lines 39-39 signals=q_sync_o
  assign q_sync_o = q_sync_d;

// AUTO-SLICE OMIT always lines 41-44

  assign q_negedge_pulse_o = ~q_sync_d & q_sync_q;

endmodule
